name: Unsavory Plant Food
summary: Halligan Turner needs ingredients for the fertilizer used by his lumber crew. You can help gather crawfish shells, manure, and Mudfin murloc heads.

sections.title: Gathering Ingredients
sections.body: Halligan Turner says the lumber crew makes its own fertilizer from crawfish shells, manure, and murloc heads. The manure comes from a ranch to the south, while the shells and heads lie in the river. He needs four Jumbo Crawfish Shells, four pieces of Fresh Manure, and eight Mudfin Murloc Heads before planting can begin.

faq.answer: Halligan needs four Jumbo Crawfish Shells, four pieces of Fresh Manure, and eight Mudfin Murloc Heads.

faq.q: What is the fertilizer made from?
faq.answer: The lumber crew's fertilizer uses crawfish shells, manure, and murloc heads in a one-to-one-to-two ratio.

faq.q: Where does the manure come from?
faq.answer: Halligan says the manure comes from a ranch to the south.

faq.q: Where are the shells and murloc heads?
faq.answer: Halligan says you need to wade into the river for the shells and murloc heads.

faq.q: Who is asking for these ingredients?
faq.answer: Halligan Turner asks for the ingredients to make fertilizer for the lumber crew.
